title: South Africa: 11 killed in attack on homestead
summary: The motive for the shooting was not immediately clear.

blocks.text: Gunmen killed 11 people at a homestead in the South African city of Durban, Kwa-Zulu Natal province's premier said on Wednesday.
The motive for the shooting was not immediately clear.

"The victims, including a pregnant woman, were gathered at a house shortly before 11:00 pm [2100 UTC] when armed assailants reportedly entered the premises and opened fire," Kwa-Zulu Premier Thamsanqa Ntuli said.
